description: This file appears to be a shell script used for testing Git's handling of line endings, especially CRLF and LF conversions, including various configurations of git attributes, autocrlf settings, and checking the effects of line ending normalization during commits and checkouts. It contains functions for setting up test files, applying different attribute configurations, and verifying the correctness of line ending conversions via comparisons.

methods.name: compare_files
methods.description: Compares two files after transforming line endings to a normalized form, used to verify line ending normalization correctness.

methods.name: compare_ws_file
methods.description: Compares two files with special handling for whitespace and control characters, ensuring line ending conversions are correct.

methods.name: create_gitattributes
methods.description: Creates a .gitattributes file with specified attributes for files, influencing line ending normalization behavior.

methods.name: create_NNO_MIX_files
methods.description: Creates test files with various line endings and attributes for testing normalization and conversion scenarios.

methods.name: check_warning
methods.description: Checks for expected warning messages during git operations related to line ending conversions.

methods.name: commit_check_warn
methods.description: Performs a series of commits with specific attributes and checks for correct warnings and behaviors.

methods.name: commit_MIX_chkwrn
methods.description: Commits files with mixed line endings and verifies warnings and normalization behavior.

methods.name: stats_ascii
methods.description: Returns a string representation of line ending style based on input, used for labeling test outputs.

methods.name: attr_ascii
methods.description: Converts attribute and eol flags into descriptive strings, used for output and comparison.

methods.name: check_files_in_repo
methods.description: Checks that the working directory files match expected state after checkout under specific configuration.

methods.name: check_in_repo_NNO
methods.description: Checks files in the repo for specific attribute settings and line ending states.

methods.name: checkout_files
methods.description: Performs checkout of files with various configurations, verifying the line endings and attributes.
